incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street with multiple buildings partially submerged in muddy floodwater. Water levels are high, reaching the bases of the buildings.

observations.description: Brown, muddy water covering the street, reaching the ground level of buildings and partially submerging lower entrances.
Buildings show no visible structural damage, but their lower floors are flooded.
Street signs (including a stop sign and directional arrow) are visible, partially submerged. A traffic light pole is also visible in the water.
A white object, possibly a bag or trash, is floating in the water on the left side.
No people are visible in the image.

inconsistencies: The report mentions 'Nabeul', but the architectural style and street signs do not match Nabeul, Tunisia. Image depicts European-style buildings with 'AT' signage, possibly Italian or similar region.
